text:
Liam: Quick question — sketching a small followup RFC. What should the minimal handshake look like between control plane and runtime across hosted / dedicated / private? Trying to avoid leaking auth/token types into the runtime.
Anya: TL;DR: keep it tiny. 3 things only: identity assertion, capability manifest, and telemetry sink hint. Secrets stay in control plane for hosted; for private we pass opaque refs. :thinking:
Sophia: +1. For private we must support customer KMS/HSM. Runtime should accept opaque key refs (e.g. kms://...) and request unwrap via control-plane bridge when needed. No raw keys ever.
Mike: Also add a lightweight probe/discovery endpoint so control plane can quickly check features and limits. Example fields: protocol_version, features[], max_seq_len, q_profiles[].
Liam: Sketch proto snippet (rough):
```json
{
  "protocol_version": "1",
  "identity": { "type": "jwt|mTLS-ref|opaque-ref" },
  "capabilities": {
    "streaming": true,
    "max_tokens": 4096,
    "kv_cache": "v2",
    "quant_profiles": ["int8","int4"]
  },
  "telemetry": {
    "sink_hint": "otel:http://collector:4318",
    "sampling": "client"  
  }
}
```
Anya: Tradeoff note — richer capability manifests let control plane do smarter routing/fallbacks but increases coupling and test surface. Propose v1 = minimal; v1-ext = opt-in fields.
Sophia: Edge case: dedicated pools that enforce tenant affinity. Manifest should expose an enum like "tenant_affinity": ["shared","tenant-bound"] so routing respects eviction/placement constraints.
Mike: infra-bot: please ensure the adapter conformance test verifies probe response within 2s and that capability keys are stable across restarts.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: conformance-check queued for adapters in staging (run id: 202).
Liam: Good. Action items: I will draft RFC patch with the proto + ext pattern; Mike will add tests to adapter-harness; Anya/Sophia will enumerate the private KMS flows and failure modes.
Mike: On it. I'll add a test matrix: hosted/dedicated/private x auth-mode x telemetry.
Anya: One more: define clear failure semantics when manifest is missing fields (fallback to conservative defaults + emit audit event).
Sophia: +1. Also add a backoff policy for control-plane->runtime probe to avoid noisy retries during maintenance.
Liam: Cool — I'll swing the RFC into a doc PR today. Ping me if you have strong objections. :thumbsup:
Mike: No objections from infra; will review PR tomorrow.
Anya: I'll add a short ops-runbook snippet for handling mismatched manifests (rollback path).
Liam: Thanks. Filing as RFC followup: boundary-proto + conformance tests.
